Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?
Absolutely! Momcozy ships to many countries and regions, including the USA, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, the UK, many EU countries, Singapore, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, South Africa, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Mexico, Indonesia, and more. Delivery is unavailable to some areas, including military bases, most overseas islands, and freight-forwarding or 3PL addresses. Shipping to Israel is temporarily suspended.
Momcozy covers customs duties for all orders except those shipped to India and these locations, where customers are responsible for applicable customs or import charges:
India, Norway, Iceland, Ukraine, Albania, Andorra, North Macedonia, Faroe Islands, Gibraltar, Moldova, San Marino, Vatican City, Kosovo, and Svalbard & Jan Mayen
The Channel Islands—Guernsey and Jersey—and the Isle of Man
If you’re ordering from one of these locations, please expect to pay any applicable customs duties or import-related charges!
